sessions.title: The Shattered Bell of Vaelmar
sessions.quote: “The sea remembers every secret, even those buried beneath its waves.”
sessions.summary: A letter from High Arcanist Elindra Voss called the old Azure Concord back into service. The party rode a storm into Vaelmar aboard the Silver Veil and found a town where the bell hadn’t rung in a decade. They followed the silence into the Bellwright catacombs and ended it in the ruined cathedral against the Corrupted Bell Archon. The bell was purified and Vaelmar was saved.
highlights: Survived the storm on the Silver Veil, harpies and all.
First Mate Havel’s hidden crate held a bell shard that hummed in their bones.
The Hanged Lute, in a town that had stopped singing.
Cultists and specters in the catacombs, and the spirit of the Bellwright: “Free the bell or all is lost.”
The Corrupted Bell Archon fell and the bell was purified.

sessions.title: The Sunken Vault of the Twin Kings
sessions.quote: “Some evils are sealed. Others are simply waiting to be found.”
sessions.summary: Under the purified church, scholars found a hidden chamber: maps, a stone disk with two crowns, and the Bell Archon’s diary. The party split. Four went up the mountain for Lord Valen on the Path of the Crown; three went in with the Ashen Covenant under Officer Kael Draven on the Path of the Flame. Each side won half a key and half a rune, and the two groups met in the Hall of Echoes, where the Covenant three turned on Kael and the paths became one.
highlights: The Covenant three solved the Rune Forge; the Legacy four faced the Five Thanes.
A stone guardian judged the party, then stepped aside.
The burning caravan: they pulled a survivor out of the wreck.
Kael’s speech in the Hall of Echoes, and the Covenant three’s answer.
The rune made whole, and the Twin King’s Gauntlet split into seven bands.
A key from the Vault of the Heart.

sessions.title: Blood in the Celebration
sessions.quote: “Heroes become legends the day someone tries to kill them.”
sessions.summary: Vaelmar threw them a celebration. The townsfolk brought gifts, and then the bell rang because someone had been shot. Guild assassins hit the plaza in Gurbleflurbleblorp’s name. At Lord Valen’s table the party was offered three roads and chose Odranard. They gave Steven the shop, played the show of their lives at the Crooked Coin, got sold out into the sewers, walked the Rat’s Nest in their attackers’ coats, and killed the Guildmistress in her own office.
highlights: The plaza attack. Elira took a crossbow bolt.
Hamptony’s chest: a shop deed, 10,000 gp in the Vaelmar bank, and an invitation to Nebulas.
Steven, Cramaris’s cousin, runs the new shop.
A person on the road who wasn’t there, a ring of falling ash, and a warm jar holding the seventh band.
The Crooked Coin show, and Rina’s five carved stones selling out.
Doss sold them out; they wore their killers’ coats through the Rat’s Nest.
Negotiations with Gurbleflurbleblorp failed. She is dead.

sessions.title: The Ash and the Ember
sessions.quote: “Four levels down. Barricade still against the door. Tea on the desk still warm.”
sessions.summary: They climbed out of the Rat’s Nest wearing the Wolf. Mabbis Crane gave them his backing, the contract floor asked for rulings and got “business as usual,” and Tannic Roe was faced down at the grate. The Guild armory outfitted them, and the road led to the Ashen Covenant camp: Ash, Kael’s warhammer, Bellamy Voss, and the Unfinished Sentinel.
highlights: Mabbis in the Ledger Room: “Fifty-one years… nobody has ever barricaded that door from the inside.”
The contract floor: keep doing things the way they’ve been done.
Tannic at the grate, stood down by a threat instead of an answer.
The Guild armory.
Ash set Kael’s warhammer on the bench and didn’t say who it was for.
Bellamy Voss, the mage from the plaza, now on their side.
The Unfinished Sentinel.
All seven Gauntlet bands are worn.
